prompt: Same style. FOREST BIOME, TERRAIN MATERIAL SHEET. Four square hand-painted tileable texture swatches, flat top-down (no perspective, no lighting gradient across the swatch, seamless edges), arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with even gaps on a plain light grey background, each with a small hand-lettered label underneath: GROUND (brown pine-needle and leaf litter with moss patches, small ferns and twigs, darker and cooler than a meadow), PATH (a faint game trail of trampled needles and dark earth with roots crossing it), CLIFF / LIP (dark mossy near-black stone with ferns and roots growing from cracks), UNDERSIDE (dark mossy stone with hanging moss and trailing roots, coolest and darkest of the four). Painterly stylized game textures: broad hand-painted brushwork, chunky readable shapes, gentle muted saturation, warm highlights and cool teal-shadow accents, not photoreal.
